evidence.currentRole: https://researchprofiles.csumb.edu/en/persons/linh-chuong/ — "Assistant Professor, Department of Health, Human Services and Public Policy". https://csumb.edu/chshs/about/dean/ explicitly groups Dr. Linh Chuong under tenure-track faculty.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://luskin.ucla.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Ninez-Alafriz-Ponce-dossier-April-2025.pdf p. 6, dissertation-chair list: "Linh Chuong (PhD 2024)". UCLA affiliation and Health Policy and Management training independently corroborated by https://uvas.healthsciences.ucla.edu/leadership-team/collaborators-and-mentees (lists PhD) and https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0069-9611 (older training record).
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given name Linh on the employer profile; additional first-person account of her Vietnamese immigrant mother: https://vietbao.com/p112a305210/2119/nguoi-viet-cua-nuoc-my-toi-hoat-dong-chinh-tri-thay-the-cho-me-toi (discovery result only; direct open returned cache miss, so not used for appointment verification).
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches with Linh Chuong, all discovered identity URLs (CSUMB person page, ORCID, PIVOT bio, UCLA CTSI person page); also ran Linh Hong Chuong alias. All returned no roster or retired-id matches. No match in already-proposed.txt.
evidence.enrichment: Employer profile supplies research areas. https://www.pivotnetwork.org/profiles/linh-chuong supplies UC Berkeley MPH and Hendrix College undergraduate degrees; these are contextual sources, not current-employer evidence. Scholar search found no verified profile. Portrait lead linked by employer: https://researchprofiles.csumb.edu/files-asset/42264576/Linh_Chuong2.jpg?f=jpg&w=160; image fetch returned cache miss, so not proposed as portraitSource. No qualifying honor verified. City omitted because the current appointment sources examined did not explicitly establish it.

evidence.currentRole: https://www.soc.ucsb.edu/people/phung-n-su — "Assistant Professor". Department faculty page and linked maintained homepage both identify her current UCSB sociology appointment.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given name Phung on the official profile and self-introduction at https://pnsu87.wixsite.com/profile. Official bio documents extensive Vietnamese migration scholarship; surname Su alone was not the screening basis.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches -- "Phung N. Su" with the official profile, personal homepage and linked Google Docs CV. No roster or retired-id matches. Manually checked name variants and already-proposed.txt; no duplicate.
evidence.enrichment: Current profile supplies research areas and Santa Barbara, CA address. Website retrieved and confirms identity through same name, UCSB appointment, email and publications. Linked CV https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XvxVbxt5PNAZKHvGzFcGjQiXcGittsNl/edit did not expose usable CV text; no doctorate year inferred. Employer page has a named headshot link, but no portrait was downloaded or visually verified. No verified Scholar profile or qualifying honor found.

evidence.currentRole: https://csapps.csueastbay.edu/directory/profiles/kpe/ojenny.html — "Professor, Co-Associate Chair", Department of Kinesiology. Current page describes her research group and 2022–27 McNair PI role.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://www.csueastbay.edu/kin/files/docs/vitae/o.pdf p. 1 records Doctor of Philosophy, Kinesiology, University of Western Ontario, 2005–2009. https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/homepage/faculty-directory.pdf explicitly records Ph.D., 2009; employer profile confirms institution and specialization. Western University is canonical name for University of Western Ontario.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given-name combination My Phung on current employer profile and employer-hosted CV, which spells full name MY PHUNG JENNY O. This lead came from given-name discovery rather than surname O.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches for My Phung Jenny O, My Phung (Jenny) O, and Jenny O with current employer profile, hosted CV, and linked Google Docs CV. All returned no roster or retired-id matches. No match in already-proposed.txt.
evidence.enrichment: Employer CV https://www.csueastbay.edu/kin/files/docs/vitae/o.pdf supports Windsor masters and Laurentian undergraduate completion in 2003. Current profile supplies research areas. Its newer CV link https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MavXSp1Of3H-ZUbcU9D_Kd0SPlFdIijnr9-6ScJLNZE/edit?usp=sharing returned a JavaScript notice. Historical CV awards are trainee awards or research grants, so no honors proposed. No verified Scholar profile found. Named portrait appears on official profile but was not visually inspected; city omitted.

evidence.currentRole: https://asa.ucdavis.edu/people/kieu-linh-valverde — "Associate Professor of Asian American Studies". https://culturalstudies.ucdavis.edu/people/kieu-linh-caroline-valverde independently repeats the rank and primary department.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://asa.ucdavis.edu/people/kieu-linh-valverde explicitly states a Ph.D. in Ethnic Studies at UC Berkeley; no year supplied. Same completed doctorate appears on https://culturalstudies.ucdavis.edu/people/kieu-linh-caroline-valverde.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given-name tokens Kieu-Linh on both official employer profiles. This does not depend on interpreting surname Valverde as Vietnamese. No original Vietnamese surname or diacritics invented.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches -- "Kieu-Linh Caroline Valverde" with both institutional profiles and the employer-linked personal website. No roster or retired-id matches. Manually searched Caroline, Valverde and Kieu-Linh variants; no duplicate. No match in already-proposed.txt.
evidence.enrichment: Official profile supplies research areas, Davis address and Berkeley undergraduate degree. Personal website is directly linked by both institutional profiles but timed out when opened; retained only as an employer-supplied link. Official profiles mention Fulbright, Rockefeller and Luce fellowships, but career/trainee eligibility was not sufficiently resolved to propose honors. No verified Scholar profile found; no portrait downloaded.

coverage.employer: California university slice — later-pass method and stopping point
coverage.note: Supplemental given-name and rare-surname pass following the earlier surname sweep. Searched institution-restricted faculty/directory queries and broader California combinations for Quynh, Thuy, Ngoc, Thao, Minh, Quang, Linh, Dung, Thanh, Hien, Thinh, Hanh, Truc, Uyen, Bich, Nhu, Chinh, Hieu, Vinh, Diem, Quyen, Huan, Khai, Thien, Thuan, Ngan, Tram, Suong, and rarer surnames Khuu, Kieu, Quach, Nghiem, Diep, Luong, Chuong, Phung, Ton-That, Thach, Trieu and Vong. Four independently verified new candidates. Stopped after broad supplemental coverage and diminishing returns, not at 25. Not an exhaustive campus census. pagesExamined lists live opened pages; query-only coverage is explicitly marked. Names in already-proposed.txt were skipped, including Nhu Y Tran Stessman, Hieu P. Nguyen and earlier California candidates. No LinkedIn page was opened; incidental search results were not used for verification. Only this JSON file written; no roster changes, tests that stamp updates, IDs, Issues, PRs or git mutations.

Deeper public-health faculty and college organization-chart check found Linh Chuong. General Pure person-directory endpoint returned 403; individual page and employer department pages worked. Linh, Thuy, Khanh, Trinh and Bui discovery searches; Phuong Tran Nguyen already covered by earlier pass.
Phung given-name search found new sociology professor Phung N. Su. Retrieved employer and linked personal pages. Prior-pass An Bui skipped.
My Phung given-name combination found Jenny O, missed by conventional surname matching. Current profile and historical education CV agree. Also searched Quoc and Dinh faculty leads.

Kieu-Linh found through given-name discovery. Both current institutional profiles confirm primary Asian American Studies appointment and Berkeley PhD. Thuan, Kieu, Truc and Uyen searches otherwise primarily alumni, trainees or existing entries.

Deeper psychology search surfaced Janice Phung and Alex Huynh; roles/degrees supported, affirmative Vietnamese evidence insufficient under brief. Given-name queries Thao, Minh, Phuong, Ngoc and Quynh mostly students. Legacy faculty.csusm.edu person URL unavailable; current campus profile worked.

PBS directory deeply screened; Uyen Minh Le and Linh Ho already rostered. CAS Tuan Tran also exact existing URL match. Current directory labels Hiep Nguyen volunteer, so not a new eligible faculty lead. No new candidate.

Math directory inspected directly: several Vietnamese names are lecturers without continuing full-time evidence. Bich-Dao Huynh historical catalog lead resolves to staff emerita. Phuong and Hoang queries mostly students and professional staff.

Given-name/rare-surname searches in medical and general faculty system: Eli Luong withheld for missing affirmative signal and brief research requirement; Thuy Tran already listed. Duy and Chinh leads primarily existing faculty or clinical profiles without additional research evidence.
